correctness.rationale: K_t is induced edge count of a uniformly random t-vertex subset of a simple 2-regular graph, hence every s-vertex union appears with q_s=binom(n-s,t-s)/binom(n,t). Exactly n adjacent unordered edge pairs yield the first two factorial-moment formulas. Unordered edge triples classified by union sizes 3,4,5,6 have counts T, n-3T, n(n-4)+3T, binom(n,3)-n(n-3)-T; multiplication by 6 gives the displayed third formula. Inclusion–exclusion q3-3q4+3q5-q6=binom(n-6,t-3)/binom(n,t) for n>=6 proves exact triangle contrast and horizon boundaries. n=3,4,5 admit only a single connected 2-regular isomorphism type C_n; n=6 supports C6 and two C3, whose complete t=3 distributions are (2,12,6,0)/20 versus (0,18,0,2)/20 and equal variance 9/25. Independent direct fixed-subset moment arithmetic confirmed all 50 (graph,horizon) cases in six test families, including n=6,7,8,9.
